items.quote: I'm going to really, you know, streamline through that. Hopefully that's going to be a very short and quick video. My name is Olga Semenka and I'm real estate sales trainer here in Dubai with my own sales experience, been in the industry for eleven years.
items.statement: Olga Semenka has eleven years of experience in real estate and has been a sales trainer for five years.

items.quote: You build engagement with the client just through the questioning him so he can communicate to himself from his mouth to his ears.
items.statement: Engagement with clients can be built by turning statements into questions, allowing clients to communicate their thoughts aloud.

items.quote: you have in his mind, in the client mind, create a gap of his knowledge, your understanding, your expertise that you, only you, because you show that the gap exists, can help him to close.
items.statement: To transition a client from chatting to a meeting, create a knowledge gap that only you can help close.

items.quote: ...I will assume the reason he is asking for discount is because he is conditioned himself through the years and years of wrong decision making...
items.statement: To provide value to a client requesting discounts, ask them about their motivations and help them understand the real value of what they are considering.

overview: Video transcript providing sales training techniques in real estate.
